name: ProcessFile.rexx
runtimeDependencies: MultiView for text, guides and images
notes: The DefIcons44 Aminet archive contains the SHA-256-identical Processfile.rexx stream, including the original line endings. The installed literal path is Rexxc/Processfile.rexx.

Stock startup starts RexxMast and adds SYS:Rexxc to the command path. Invoke the installed script through RX. TXT and GUIDE dispatch to MultiView. HTML reaches OpenURL with its stock execute protection.
Rexxc is shared with the existing AmigaOS and EjectADF scripts. Default icons and DoMIME keep their separate ownership.
